To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have successfully fabricated low cost quasi solid-state DSSCs with a PVA: Ppy: KI: I2 polymer electrolyte and achieved an efficiency of 4%.
the performance of the DSSC is enhanced by increasing the PPy content and it can be used in low cost DSSCs.
the PVA:PPy (85:10 wt%) based polymer electrolyte showed better performance for low cost DSSCs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and characterization of PPy based PVA/ PPy/ KI/I2 polymer electrolyte for low cost quasi solid DSSC application.
the synthesis of PPy/PVA based polymer electrolyte and its use in DSSC.
the development of a novel conducting polymer electrolyte for low cost quasi solid dye sensitized solar energy conversion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present work has demonstrated the potential of PVA:PPy based electrolyte for the fabrication of low cost and efficient DSSCs with the possibility of commercialization.
the PPy content plays a vital role in the conductivity of the polymer electrolyte which in turn influences the performance of DSSCs.
the addition of PPy in PVA polymer electrolyte is a promising material for low cost DSSCs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the PVA/PPy/ KI/ I2 polymer electrolyte has been used as a quasi solid state electrolyte for low cost DSSCs and the PVA (85%)/PPy (10%)/KI (5%)/I2 polymer electrolytes exhibited excellent performance in terms of short circuit current, open circuit voltage, fill factor and photovoltaic energy conversion efficiency.
the DSSC based on PVA (85%) PPy (10%) KI (5%) I2 polymer electrolyte showed better efficiency and stability.
the DSSC fabricated with PPy incorporated polymer electrolyte shows the better performance than the DSSC without PPy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PPy content of the polymer electrolyte plays a vital role in the performance of DSSCs.
the PPy based PVA: PVA polymer electrolytes can be used as an effective quasi solid electrolyte for DSSC.
the performance of DSSCs can be enhanced by using PPy as a conducting polymer additive in the polymer electrolyte.
